categories.main_business_segments: Ingersoll Rand operates two primary business segments: Industrial Technologies and Services, which provides air and gas compression, vacuum and blower products, fluid transfer equipment, loading systems, power tools, and lifting equipment; and Precision and Science Technologies, which offers specialized pumps, fluid management, powder handling, and contract manufacturing for industrial and life sciences markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages a broad range of technologies including rotary screw, reciprocating piston, scroll, rotary vane, and centrifugal compressors; side channel, liquid ring, claw, screw, and rotary vane vacuum pumps; and various blower technologies. In Precision and Science Technologies, it utilizes positive displacement pumps (diaphragm, vane, piston, peristaltic, gear), automated liquid handling, single-use containment systems, and advanced controls and software, with increasing integration of IIoT and automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ingersoll Rand serves a diverse customer base across industrial manufacturing, life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, water and wastewater, chemical processing, infrastructure, agriculture, and aerospace. Customers include end-users, OEMs, EPC firms, and are reached both directly and through a global network of distributors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with sales and operations in all major regions, including the Americas, EMEIA (Europe, Middle East, India, and Africa), and Asia Pacific (notably China). In 2024, 57% of revenues were generated outside the United States, with over 60 manufacturing facilities and 40+ service centers across six continents.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ingersoll Rand operates primarily as an original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and aftermarket service provider, positioned downstream in the supply chain by delivering finished products, systems, and services directly to end-users and through distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in flow creation, energy efficiency, sustainability, and digitalization, including IIoT and AI integration. Strategic priorities include expanding through acquisitions, developing new products for high-growth and sustainable markets, and enhancing aftermarket and service offerings. R&D spending in 2024 was $116.6 million, focused on new product development and application engineering.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through the sale of original equipment, aftermarket parts, consumables, and services. The company benefits from a significant recurring revenue stream, with aftermarket sales representing 36.4% of total revenue in 2024. Sales are made both directly and via independent distributors, with some long-term service and engineered-to-order contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors in Industrial Technologies and Services include Atlas Copco, Flowserve, IDEX Corporation, and Kaeser Compressors; in Precision and Science Technologies, competitors include Dover, Graco, IDEX, KNF Neuberger, Netzsch, NOV, Sartorius, SPX Flow, Thermo Fisher, and Watson-Marlow. Ingersoll Rand holds leading market positions in its core segments, supported by strong brands and a broad product portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Ingersoll Rand reported revenues of $7.24 billion, up 5.2% from 2023, with net income of $838.6 million and Adjusted EBITDA of $2.02 billion (27.9% margin). The company has demonstrated consistent growth through both organic initiatives and acquisitions, with a robust balance sheet and significant global scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ingersoll Rand differentiates itself through a comprehensive and technologically advanced product portfolio, global service network, application expertise, and strong aftermarket support. Its products are mission-critical, known for reliability, efficiency, and quality, and the company emphasizes minimizing customer downtime, maximizing operational efficiency, and supporting sustainability goals.
